text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A British organisation urges the new British government to cooperate with Iraq.
- Trade Ministry reduces prices of flour sold in its shopping centres.
- Iraq and Tunisia sign a trade cooperation agreement.
- Iraq commemorates anniversary of death of former defence minister General Adnan Kharallah.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Iraq's Health Minister Umeed Madhat Mubarak leaves for Geneva to attend meeting of the World Health Organisation.
